title: Haptic Speaking Pacer
user: A presenter, teacher, or person practicing clear speech who needs a discreet tactile cue when their pace drifts too fast, without watching a screen.
smallest_useful_product: A watch companion that learns a baseline from a short practice sample, detects only speech activity/estimated words-per-minute, and sends configurable haptic nudges with a post-session private chart.
success_measure: In three rehearsed talks, a user stays within their selected pace band for 70% of speaking time without looking at a display.
constraints: On-device processing only; battery and microphone permission disclosure; pace estimates are approximate and not clinical speech assessment.
